sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.5398 of 2021
Order:
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents and perused the record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the absolute owner and possessor of the land in Sy.No.52/A, admeasuring Ac.6-97 cents situated at Lakshmidevipur Village, Chinna Chintakunta Mandal, Mahabubnagar District.

While it being so, the Government of Telangana acquired 56 cents out of Ac.6-97 cents of the land from Sy.No.52/A, for the purpose of canal to provide water to agricultural land from Undyala Village towards Chintakunta.

Thereafter, the petitioner had furnished the Revenue Records and Title Deeds before the respondents and the authorities have issued proceedings on 25.03.2015 and 26.03.2015 including Form No.8, wherein the ::2::
SK, J name of the petitioner was reflected and an amount of Rs.1,47,325/- was fixed as compensation in favour of the petitioner herein.
Thereafter, one Mrs.Ratnamma filed a Civil Suit against one Mr.Ram Krishna for Sy.No.52/AA, but no orders were passed in her favour and the same is pending.

Thereafter, the petitioner got issued legal notices on 27.08.2018 and 11.03.2019 and a final representation on 05.01.2021,
for release of compensation for acquired land.
But, no action has been taken by the respondents on the ground that a case is pending in respect of land in Sy.No.52.
Moreover, the petitioner's land is in Sy.No.52/A and the petitioner is not the party in the Civil Suit filed by the said Mrs.Ratnamma.
Aggrieved by the inaction of the respondents, the present Writ Petition is filed and requested this Court to allow the Writ Petition.

3. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents, basing on the counter-affidavit, submits that the petitioner is one ::3::
SK, J of the share holder of the land bearing Sy.No.52/AA covering an extent of Ac.6.17gts situated at Lakshmidevpur Village, Chinna Chinta Kunta Mandal,
Mahabubnagar District, the petitioner is the owner of the land to an extent of Ac.0.54cts from the land in Sy.No.52/AA and the said land is proposed for acquisition for excavation of Minor-20 on Distributory- 12 of Link Canal of Koilsagar Lift Irrigation Scheme Sate-II from KM 0.159 to KM 1.881.
4.

Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition further submits that as per the Award Proceedings No.A/134/2011, dated 25.03.2015, Form-8 was issued and the compensation amount to each pattadar was specified as per the Survey Numbers, wherein an amount of Rs.1,47,325/- has P. sentences.text:
Aggrieved by the said Award proceedings dated 25.03.2015,
one Smt.Ratnamma R/o Laxmidevpur Village, Chinn Chinta Kunta, has filed a representation before the ::4::
SK, J Land Acquisition Office on 09.04.2015 stating that the Award which was passed for the land bearing Sy.No.52 admeasuring an extent of Ac.0.54 cents is in favour of Sri.P.Subba Rao S/o Laxmaiah, wherein the share of Smt.Ratnamma is also including in the said extent of land and requested for payment of compensation in her favour.
5.

Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition further submits that the said Smt.Ratnamma filed O.S.No.27 of 2016, before the Senior Civil Judge, Gadwal, stating that the title dispute is pending in respect of said survey number, and requested not to pass any order.

After completion of three (03) years from the date of Award, the petitioner herein has filed petitions before the Land Acquisition Officer on 27.08.2018, 11.03.2019 and 05.01.2021, stating that the land in Sy.No.52 admeasuring to an extent of Ac.0.54 cts situated in Laxmidevpur Village, Chinna Chinta Kunta was ::5::
SK, J acquired under Land Acquisition Act, 2013, wherein the petitioner is also a patta holder and requested for payment of compensation.

The concerned officials had issued an endorsement No.A/134/2011, dated 15.06.2018 stating that the objection petition before the Land Acquisition Officer and O.S.No.27 of 2016, before the Senior Civil Judge, Gadwal, which are filed by Smt.Ratnamma are pending and the Land Acquisition Officer, Mahabubnagar, has treated that the land in question is under title dispute.

6. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition further submits that the land in Sy.Nos.48, 51,
52, 55, 56, 58 and 60 admeasuring to an extent of Ac.3.34cts situated in Laxmidevpur Village,
Chinna Chinta Kunta Mandal, have been acquired for excavation of Minor-20 on Distributory-12 of Link Canal of Koilsagar Lift Irrigation Scheme Sate-II from KM 0.159 to KM 1.881, wherein the petitioner's land was also included and the authorities vide Award ::6::
SK, J Proceedings No.A/134/2011, dated 25.03.2015 had fixed the compensation amount of Rs.1,47,325/- in the name of the petitioner and except the land in the aforesaid survey numbers, no further lands were acquired which belongs to the petitioner, as of now there are no funds available in the account of the Special Deputy Collector, Unit-II, Mahabubnagar for payment of compensation to the land losers and for want of requisite budget, the correspondence has been made with Executive Engineer, Irrigation, Division No.3, Devakardra and for the said funds will be sanctioned under the concerned G.O. therefore, after the receipt of the requisite budget from the Executive Engineer, Irrigation, Division No.3, Devakardra, the compensation amount pending to the land losers and the writ petitioner will be paid and requested to dismiss the writ petition.

sentences.text:
After hearing both sides, this Court is of the considered view that the petitioner is the absolute ::7::
SK, J owner of the land to an extent of Ac.6-97 cents in Sy.No.52/A situated at Lakshmidevipur Village, Chinna Chintakunta Mandal, Mahabubnagar District.

The respondent-authorities have acquired the land of the petitioner to an extent of Ac.0.56 cents out of Ac.6-97 cents of the land from Sy.No.52/A, for the purpose of canal to provide water to agricultural land from Undyala Village towards Chintakunta.

The respondent authorities have issued Land Acquisition proceedings and the Land Acquisition Officer passed an Award vide Proceedings No.A/134/2011,
dated 25.03.2015 and in the said award, the Land Acquisition Officer has given finding that the petitioner was entitled to receive land acquisition compensation to an amount of Rs.1,47,325/- and issued Form-8.
After passing of the Award, the third parties filed an application before the Land Acquisition Officer and also filed a suit in O.S.No.27 of 2016 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Gadwal.

In view of the same,
the respondent- ::8::
SK, J authorities have not released the amount to the petitioner.
But, the petitioner is not a party to the suit in O.S.No.27 of 2016.
8. The Land Acquisition Officer has no power and jurisdiction to withhold the amount after passing of the Award on the ground of Civil Suits are pending.
If any dispute after passing of Award with regard to the acquired land, the interested party should approach the authorities under Land Acquisition Act, 2013 by filing an appropriate petition.
But, the Land Acquisition Officer has no jurisdiction to entertain any objections after passing an Award.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has rightly contended that without any findings by the Competent Authority or by the Civil Court, the Land Acquisition Officer has no right to withhold Compensation, which is entitled by the petitioner.

9. In view of the same, this Writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondent No.2 to release ::9::
SK, J the compensation amount due to the petitioner along with interest as per Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a period of three (03) months from the date of receipt of a copy of the order.
